autodoc_attrs_class: decorate an attrs class to auto-generate Sphinx docstrings from attribute metadata and type hints
type_to_sphinx_convert: convert a Python type object to a Sphinx-compatible type string for documentation
autodoc_with_defaults: use autodoc on an attrs class with default values to include defaults in generated docstrings
autodoc_private_fields: apply autodoc to an attrs class with private fields to strip leading underscores in docs
autodoc_fix_indent: use autodoc to fix indentation in existing class docstrings before appending parameter sections
